man1.prompt_en: Young adult male, slender athletic build; short, layered two-tone dark blue/black hair with prominent light streaks, specifically featuring a prominent light streak over his right eye, choppy bangs covering the forehead; fair skin with brown eyes; wears an adventurer's outfit consisting of a textured tunic, belts across the chest, and shoulder guards featuring cross-stitch patterns.
man1.prompt_ch: 年轻的成年男性，身材苗条且具运动感；留着短的有层次感的双色深蓝/黑色头发，带有明显的浅色挑染，特别是右眼上方有一道明显的浅色挑染，不规则的刘海遮住额头；白皙的皮肤，棕色的眼睛；身穿冒险者服装，包括有质感的上衣、胸前交叉的腰带，以及带有十字缝线图案的护肩。

man2.prompt_en: Young adult; seen only as a background silhouette with a prominent horn centered on the forehead; wears a dark, long-sleeved upper garment with a striped cuff visible on the reaching hand.
man2.prompt_ch: 年轻成年人；仅作为一个带有额头中央突出独角的背景剪影出现；身穿深色长袖上衣，伸出的手上可见条纹袖口。

elf1.prompt_en: Young female elf, slender feminine figure; long straight silver-white hair with neat bangs and longer sidelocks; fair skin with purple eyes, prominent pointed elf ears; wears a sleeveless adventurer top, arm guards, and a skirt.
elf1.prompt_ch: 年轻的女性精灵，身材纤细充满女性魅力；留着长直的银白色头发，有着整齐的刘海和较长的鬓发；白皙的皮肤，紫色的眼睛，醒目的尖尖精灵耳朵；身穿无袖冒险者上衣，佩戴护臂和裙子。

Plot Correspondence.en: man1 enthusiastically declares the start of the leveling fest.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 男人1充满热情地宣布升级节的开始。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. A bright, undefined space with a completely white background.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。一个明亮且未定义的空间，背景完全是白色的。

Static Shot Description.en: man1's face is positioned in the center of the screen, facing screen left with a confident, eager smile, his head tilted slightly forward.
Static Shot Description.ch: 男人1的脸位于画面中央，面向画面左侧，带着自信且渴望的微笑，头部微微前倾。

Plot Correspondence.en: elf1 notices a chubby reptilian monster dancing nearby and looks at it in confusion.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 精灵1注意到附近有一只胖乎乎的爬行动物怪物在跳舞，困惑地看着它。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. A tropical outdoor setting. Dark, heavily shaded palm tree fronds hang down from the top left corner. Floating Japanese sound effects are near the leaves. The ground is dirt or sand.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。热带户外环境。深色且带有浓重阴影的棕榈树叶从左上角垂下。树叶附近漂浮着日语拟声词。地面是泥土或沙子。

Static Shot Description.en: elf1 sits on the left side of the screen beneath the palm fronds, facing slightly right. She points with both index fingers towards the right side of the screen, where a single small, chubby lizard-like monster is balancing on one foot with the other lifted in a mid-step dancing motion, smiling happily. elf1 looks at it with a curious, slightly puzzled expression.
Static Shot Description.ch: 精灵1坐在画面左侧的棕榈树叶下，微微朝右看。她用双手的食指指向画面右侧，那里有一只小巧、胖乎乎的蜥蜴般怪物正单脚站立，另一只脚抬起做跳舞的动作，开心地笑着。精灵1带着好奇和略微不解的表情看着它。

Plot Correspondence.en: man1 calls out while rushing past, startling elf1 who reaches out urgently and questions what he has done.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 男人1飞奔而过时大声呼唤，吓到了精灵1，她急忙伸出手并质问他做了什么。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. Abstract background consisting entirely of curved and diagonal speed lines indicating rapid motion.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。抽象的背景，完全由弯曲和对角的粗体速度线组成，表示快速移动。

Shot Perspective Design.en: Close-up action shot with extreme perspective
Shot Perspective Design.ch: 具有极度透视感的动作特写镜头

Static Shot Description.en: On the right side of the screen, elf1's right hand is drawn extremely large and close to the camera in the foreground, reaching out with an open palm in a gesture of urgency. In the upper left background, the small silhouette of man2 is visible, with sweat drops indicating surprise or shock, as a blurred figure rushes past.
Static Shot Description.ch: 在画面右侧，精灵1的右手被画得极大且紧贴前景的镜头，张开手掌伸出，手势急迫。在左上方的背景中，可以看到男人2的小剪影，伴有表示惊讶或震惊的汗滴，同时一个模糊的身影飞奔而过。

Plot Correspondence.en: elf1 freezes in utter shock as she realizes the extent of the trouble happening off-screen.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 当意识到画外发生的麻烦程度时，精灵1在极度震惊中僵住了。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. A stark white background with a single jagged action line on the right side to emphasize a sudden realization.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。纯白的背景，右侧有一条锯齿状的动作线，以强调突然的醒悟。

Static Shot Description.en: elf1's face is positioned centrally, facing screen right with an expression of intense shock: her eyes are wide with small pupils, manga-style vertical shading lines are drawn on her forehead, her mouth is agape, and exactly one drop of sweat drips down her cheek.
Static Shot Description.ch: 精灵1的脸位于画面中央，面向画面右侧，表情极度震惊：她的眼睛睁得很大，瞳孔很小，额头上画有漫画风格的垂直阴影线，嘴巴张开，脸颊上刚好流下一滴汗。

Plot Correspondence.en: man1 flees in a panic, chased by a massive stampede of giant monsters, questioning why there are so many of them.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 男人1在逃跑时惊慌失措，被一大群巨大的怪物追赶，质问为什么有这么多怪物。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. A barren, dusty terrain. A massive, billowing cloud of dust fills the entire background.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。荒芜多尘的地形。巨大的、翻滚的灰尘云填满了整个背景。

Static Shot Description.en: In the center foreground, man1 is running frantically directly towards the camera, firmly holding a sheathed sword horizontally across his body. He wears a strained, nervous smile and a sweat drop. Directly behind him, emerging from a massive dust cloud that covers the upper half of the screen, a stampede of exactly five giant, bulky lizard monsters with large, toothy jaws furiously chase him.
Static Shot Description.ch: 在中央前景中，男人1正疯狂地径直跑向镜头，双手横握着一把带鞘的剑贴在身前。他带着勉强、紧张的微笑，额头滴着汗。在他正后方，恰好有五只体型庞大、长着长满利齿的大嘴的蜥蜴怪物，从覆盖画面上半部的大片沙尘暴中冲出，疯狂地追赶他。

Plot Correspondence.en: man1 strikes down one of the lizard monsters with a decisive and powerful mid-air attack.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 男人1用决定性且有力的半空攻击击倒了其中一只蜥蜴怪物。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. The background is completely filled with thick, diagonal action speed lines and large, thick black impact streaks and shapes emphasizing a fast downward strike.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。背景完全填满了密集的对角线动作速度线和巨大粗壮的黑色冲击条纹和形状，以强调快速的向下重击。

Static Shot Description.en: On the right side of the screen, man1 is suspended in mid-air, facing screen left, leaning forward with a manic, bright smile as he swings his sword downwards. On the left side of the screen, the large head of a lizard monster occupies the foreground; its single visible eye is replaced by an 'X' and its jaw hangs completely slack, indicating it has just been struck and knocked out. At the very bottom left corner, directly below the monster's head, a single clawed hand or foot is visible.
Static Shot Description.ch: 在画面右侧，男人1悬在半空中，面向左侧，身体前倾，带着狂热、明亮的微笑向下挥剑。在画面左侧，一只蜥蜴怪物的大头占据了前景；它唯一可见的眼睛变成了一个“X”，下巴完全松弛地垂着，表明它刚刚被击中并被打晕。在最左下角，怪物的头正下方，可以看到一只带爪的手或脚。
